effects.label: Kusarikku - Laceration DMG

effects.label: Girtablullu - Stagnant Aberrant - Anomaly DMG
effects.description: When an Agent inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the target enemy gains 1 stack of Blight Mark of the corresponding attribute, lasting 30s and stacking up to 2 times. For every stack of Blight Mark inflicted, the enemies take 8% more Attribute Anomaly DMG, and DMG taken by Corruptive Barried increased by 8%. ...
